DEED OF TRUST, ASSIGNMENT OF RENTS, SECURITY AGREEMENT AND FIXTURE FILING

THIS DEED OF TRUST is made as of March 14, 2026, by HALLORAN INSTRUMENTS, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, whose address is 1400 Foundry Road, Wilmington, Delaware 19801 ("Trustor"), to FIRST CAROLINA TITLE COMPANY, a North Carolina corporation ("Trustee"), for the benefit of MERIDIAN COMMUNITY BANK, N.A., whose address is 200 Tryon Street, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202 ("Beneficiary").

FOR VALUABLE CONSIDERATION, Trustor irrevocably grants, transfers, and assigns to Trustee, in trust, with power of sale, all of Trustor's right, title, and interest in and to the real property located in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, more particularly described on Exhibit A attached hereto and incorporated herein (the "Property"), together with all buildings, improvements, fixtures, easements, and appurtenances now or hereafter located thereon.

1. OBLIGATIONS SECURED. This Deed of Trust secures (a) payment of the indebtedness evidenced by that certain Promissory Note of even date herewith in the original principal amount of $4,750,000 made by Trustor payable to the order of Beneficiary (the "Note"), with a maturity date of March 14, 2036; (b) performance of each covenant of Trustor contained herein; and (c) payment of all sums advanced by Beneficiary to protect the Property.

2. ASSIGNMENT OF RENTS. Trustor absolutely and unconditionally assigns to Beneficiary all rents, issues, and profits of the Property. So long as no Event of Default exists, Trustor is granted a license to collect and retain the rents as they become due. Upon an Event of Default, the license terminates automatically and Beneficiary may collect the rents directly.

3. TAXES AND INSURANCE. Trustor shall pay all real property taxes and assessments before delinquency, and shall maintain all-risk property insurance on the improvements in an amount not less than the full replacement cost, and commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate, naming Beneficiary as mortgagee and additional insured.

4. MAINTENANCE. Trustor shall keep the Property in good condition and repair, shall not commit or permit waste, and shall not demolish or materially alter any improvement without Beneficiary's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

5. DUE ON SALE. If Trustor sells, conveys, or otherwise transfers all or any part of the Property or any interest therein without Beneficiary's prior written consent, Beneficiary may, at its option, declare all sums secured immediately due and payable.

6. EVENTS OF DEFAULT. Each of the following constitutes an Event of Default: (a) failure to pay any installment under the Note within ten (10) days after its due date; (b) failure to perform any other covenant contained herein that continues for thirty (30) days after written notice from Beneficiary; (c) any representation made by Trustor proving false in any material respect when made; or (d) the filing of a petition in bankruptcy by or against Trustor that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

7. REMEDIES; POWER OF SALE. Upon an Event of Default, Beneficiary may declare all sums secured immediately due and payable and may direct Trustee to sell the Property at public auction pursuant to the power of sale granted herein and in accordance with Article 2A of Chapter 45 of the North Carolina General Statutes. Trustee shall give notice of hearing and notice of sale as required by N.C. Gen. Stat. § 45-21.16 and § 45-21.17. The proceeds of any sale shall be applied first to the costs of sale, then to the indebtedness secured, and the surplus, if any, to the person legally entitled thereto.

8. NO DEFICIENCY LIMITATION WAIVER. Nothing in this Deed of Trust waives any limitation on deficiency judgments available to Trustor under N.C. Gen. Stat. § 45-21.36.

9. RECONVEYANCE. Upon payment in full of all sums secured, Beneficiary shall request Trustee to reconvey the Property, and Trustee shall reconvey without warranty to the person legally entitled thereto. The recitals in the reconveyance of any matters of fact are conclusive proof of their truthfulness.

10. SUBSTITUTION OF TRUSTEE. Beneficiary may from time to time substitute a successor trustee by an instrument recorded in the office of the Register of Deeds of Mecklenburg County, and the successor shall succeed to all title, powers, and duties conferred upon Trustee herein.

11. GOVERNING LAW. This Deed of Trust is governed by the laws of the State of North Carolina, and any action to enforce it shall be brought in the Superior Court of Mecklenburg County, North Carolina.

12. NOTICES. All notices shall be in writing and given by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses set forth above, or to such other address as a party designates by notice.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Trustor has executed this Deed of Trust as of the date first written above.

HALLORAN INSTRUMENTS, LLC
By: /s/ Dermot Halloran
Dermot Halloran, Manager

STATE OF DELAWARE, COUNTY OF NEW CASTLE
